Bootstrap confidence scores for every group in a cell type tree

Source: R/bootstrapConfidence.R
bootstrapLineageConfidence.Rd

For each group in cellTypeTree that has children (see cellTypeTree), runs bootstrapClassify() on that group's cells to get, for every cell, a confidence score for each of the group's child cell types. The result is the confList used by the downstream analyses, such as runProportionsPipeline() and runColocalisationModels(). Cell types without a group (ungrouped leaves) are not refined and keep hard labels.

Usage

bootstrapLineageConfidence(
  spe,
  cellTypeTree,
  nBoot = 100,
  nPerClass = 50,
  cores = 1,
  seed = 51773,
  skipGroups = character(0),
  subprocess = FALSE,
  classifier = c("pcaLogistic", "logistic", "rf", "lda", "svm"),
  ntree = 500,
  priors = c("balanced", "observed"),
  correctedCounts = FALSE,
  cellType = "cellType",
  cellID = "cellID",
  assayName = "counts"
)

Arguments

spe

A SummarizedExperiment (e.g. SpatialExperiment) with a counts assay and per-cell cell type labels and unique cell IDs in colData.

cellTypeTree

A cell type tree, see cellTypeTree.

nBoot

Number of bootstrap resamples.

nPerClass

Minimum number of training cells per class; classes smaller than this are up-sampled with replacement.

cores

Number of cores to run the bootstrap resamples on (forked with BiocParallel); the default runs serially. On Windows, where forking is not available, it always runs serially. If seed is given, the results are identical whatever the number of cores.

seed

Random seed, or NULL for no fixed seed. Each group is bootstrapped with seed plus its position in the list of groups, so every group is reproducible independently of the others.

skipGroups

Names of groups to leave out of the result.

subprocess

If TRUE, each group is bootstrapped in a fresh R session (via callr), which only holds that group's counts. With cores above 1, every worker starts as a copy of the session it is forked from, so this keeps the workers small on large data. It requires the same version of fuzzyCell to be installed.

classifier

One of "pcaLogistic" (ridge multinomial logistic regression, via glmnet, with the penalty chosen by cross-validation, on the first 50 principal components of the training cells, computed exactly for up to 5,000 genes and with irlba beyond; the default), "logistic" (the same on all genes), "rf" (random forest, via randomForest), "lda" (linear discriminant analysis, via MASS) or "svm" (support vector machine, via e1071).

ntree

Number of trees; only used when classifier = "rf".

priors

The classifier is trained with balanced classes, which gives every class the same prior. "balanced" keeps those equal priors; "observed" weights each class by its share of the cells, so a resample is assigned to its most probable class given how common the classes are.

correctedCounts

FALSE (the default) requires whole-number counts. TRUE also accepts counts that are not whole numbers, such as counts corrected for ambient RNA, and resamples them as they are. They must still be on the scale of molecule counts: a cell's resample draws as many transcripts as its total (rounded), so normalised or log-transformed values would give the wrong amount of resampling noise.

cellType

Name of the colData(spe) column holding each cell's cell type label.

cellID

Name of the colData(spe) column holding unique cell IDs. They are returned in the cellID column of each result.

assayName

Name of the assay with the raw counts.

Value

A named list with one element per group (named by group). Groups with no cells, or with only one cell type present, cannot be bootstrapped: they are skipped with a message and left out of the list. Each element is a data.frame with one row per cell in that group, a cellID column, and one column per child cell type of the group holding the cell's confidence score for that cell type (between 0 and 1, rows summing to 1 across the child columns). Each data frame also carries a "settings" attribute recording how it was computed (nBoot, nPerClass, classifier, priors, correctedCounts, ntree, the group's seed, its children and the fuzzyCellVersion).

Examples

data(lungSubset)
data(lungCellTypeTree)
confList = bootstrapLineageConfidence(lungSubset, lungCellTypeTree, nBoot = 5,
    seed = 1)
